# Read in Data

```{r}
# Read in Data
setwd("/Users/chenmingyang/Desktop/best_judges_vs_machine")
data <- read.csv("best_judges.csv")
```

# basic results

```{r}
# Compare best judges with machine
# define data
data$machine <- ifelse(data$slope_machine1 > 0, "biased", "unbiased")
data$judge <- ifelse(data$slope_judge > 0, "biased", "unbiased")

# get table data
table_data <- table(
  Group = rep(c("judge", "machine"), each = nrow(data)),
  Result = c(data$judge, data$machine)
)
table_data <- table_data[2:1, ]
print(table_data)
```

# create basic data

```{r}
# calculate judge biased situations
judges_code <- data$法官姓名编码
judges_code <- unique(judges_code)
judges_code <- na.omit(judges_code)
data <- na.omit(data)
### get target frame
judge_performance <- data.frame(
  code = judges_code,
  rate = rep(NA, length(judges_code)), 
  biasNum = rep(NA, length(judges_code)),
  total = rep(NA, length(judges_code))
)

# create the performance data_frame
for (i in 1: length(judges_code)) {
  data_evaluate <- subset(data, 法官姓名编码 == judges_code[i])
  division <- sum(data_evaluate$judge == "biased", na.rm=TRUE) / length(data_evaluate$编号)
  number <- sum(data_evaluate$judge == "biased", na.rm=TRUE)
  tot <- length(data_evaluate$编号)
  judge_performance$rate[i] <- division
  judge_performance$biasNum[i] <- number
  judge_performance$total[i] <- tot
}

# calculate performance situation
sum(judge_performance$rate >= 0.1098069, na.rm=TRUE)
length(judge_performance$code)

# prepare for the rest job
library(ggplot2)
```

# create: all judges

```{r}
# all judges
# xpercent
judge_new1 <- judge_performance
biasedcases1 <- judge_new1$biasNum
x_percent1 <- (1:length(judges_code))/length(judges_code) * 100
# ypercent
sorted_values1 <- sort(biasedcases1, decreasing = TRUE)
cumulative_sum1 <- cumsum(sorted_values1)
y_percent1 <- cumulative_sum1 / sum(sorted_values1) * 100

# create frames
data_all <- data.frame(
  x = x_percent1,
  y = y_percent1,
  group = "All Judges"
)
```

# create: at least 2 cases

```{r}
# 2 cases
judge_new2 <- subset(judge_performance, total > 1)
biasedcases2 <- judge_new2$biasNum
x_percent2 <- (1:length(judge_new2$code))/length(judge_new2$code) * 100

sorted_values2 <- sort(biasedcases2, decreasing = TRUE)
cumulative_sum2 <- cumsum(sorted_values2)
y_percent2 <- cumulative_sum2 / sum(sorted_values2) * 100

# create frames
data_min2 <- data.frame(
  x = x_percent2,
  y = y_percent2,
  group = "At Least 2 Cases"
)
```

# create: at least 10 cases

```{r}
# 10 cases
# xpercent
judge_new3 <- subset(judge_performance, total >= 10)
biasedcases3 <- judge_new3$biasNum
x_percent3 <- (1:length(judge_new3$code))/length(judge_new3$code) * 100
# ypercent
sorted_values3 <- sort(biasedcases3, decreasing = TRUE)
cumulative_sum3 <- cumsum(sorted_values3)
y_percent3 <- cumulative_sum3 / sum(sorted_values3) * 100

# create frames
data_min10 <- data.frame(
  x = x_percent3,
  y = y_percent3,
  group = "At Least 10 Cases"
)
```

# plot1

```{r}
# combine cases
combined_data <- rbind(data_all, data_min2, data_min10)

# stats table
stats_text <- paste0(
  "Sample Sizes:\n",
  "All Judges: ", length(judges_code), "\n",
  "At Least 2 Cases: ", length(judge_new2$code), "\n",
  "At Least 10 Cases: ", length(judge_new3$code)
)

# draw plot
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = x, y = y, color = group)) +
  
  # labels
  labs(
    title = "Judges' Decision Distribution",
    subtitle = "Cumulative biased cases by judge experience",
    x = "Cumulative Judges (%)",
    y = "Cumulative Biased Cases (%)",
    color = "Judge Group"
  ) +
  
  # panel
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = seq(0, 100, 10)) +
  
  # lines
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  
  # 50% reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.5) +

  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "gray50", size = 9, hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  
  # color
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "All Judges" = "red",
    "At Least 2 Cases" = "blue",
    "At Least 10 Cases" = "darkgreen"
  )) + 
   geom_point(size = 0) + 
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 15, size = 4, 
        alpha = 1, 
        linetype = 0)))

```


# calculate comparison results.

```{r}

# create frames
performance_comp <- data.frame(
  type = c("all judges", "two cases", "ten cases", "rate", "only ten"),
  worse = rep(NA, 5), 
  better = rep(NA, 5),
  total = rep(NA, 5)
)

for(i in 1:5) {
  # get df name
  df_name <- paste0("judge_new", i)
  df <- get(df_name)
  
  # calculate values
  performance_comp$worse[i] <- sum(df$rate >= 0.1098069, na.rm=TRUE)
  performance_comp$total[i] <- length(df$code)
  performance_comp$better[i] <- performance_comp$total[i] - performance_comp$worse[i]
}

# get ratio
performance_comp$ratio <- performance_comp$worse / performance_comp$total

# print
print(performance_comp)

df <- data.frame(
  value = c(judge_new3$rate, judge_new5$rate),
  group = factor(rep(c("At Least 10 Cases", "Only 10 Cases"),times = c(2013,281))))

ggplot(df, aes(x = value, fill = group)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Judge Decision", x = "Bias Rate", y = "Frequency") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("orange", "blue", "green")) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.1098069, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") + theme_bw()
```
